author: Oussanoux
quote: What a **** disappointment. Rockstar turned GTA into a boring life simulator. Grocery shopping, gym routines, house chores and babysitting Lucia? ARE YOU **** SERIOUS? I bought GTA to rob, shoot, drive, cause chaos and have a laugh, not to play house husband. The story is painfully boring, the humour is dead, and the freedom that made GTA legendary feels watered down. Michael, Franklin and Trevor had more personality in their little finger than this entire experience. Stop shoving forced realism and romance down our throats. I WANT GRAND THEFT AUTO, NOT THE **** SIMS WITH GUNS.
